claim_boundary: This is the honest terminal record from the sole public synthetic four-template development execution. It is not capability evidence. The run trained the fixed inc/+1, dec/-1, dbl/*2, and neg/-x episodes and entered teacher-free DEV. During generation for one of the first three DEV prompts, the native runtime latched a scientific stop. The fixture caught that original generation exception but deferred artifact publication and continued; the following DEV advance then failed closed as already poisoned. Consequently the exact original stop and preceding DEV identity were not recoverable after process exit. No rerun, tuning, native change, held-out access, C1 access, or target feedback followed.
